helpTopics.title: Home dashboard
helpTopics.summary: Start here: launch tasks from Quick actions, reopen Recent activity, and jump to Favorites.

helpTopics.title: Surveys collection
helpTopics.summary: Filter, sort, personalize columns, and save views of your survey catalog. Rows are read-only demo data.

helpTopics.title: Responses collection
helpTopics.summary: Review incoming responses with score, device, and completion insights. Export any view.

helpTopics.title: Participants collection
helpTopics.summary: Search respondent profiles, regions, and opt-in status.

helpTopics.title: Launch a survey
helpTopics.summary: A guided multi-step task. Your draft is saved automatically so you can resume later.

tourSteps.title: Welcome to Survey Hub
tourSteps.body: This is your operations workspace. Use the navigation on the left to move between Surveys, Responses, and Participants.

tourSteps.title: Find anything fast
tourSteps.body: Press Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Mac) to search across pages, records, and saved views from anywhere.

tourSteps.title: Launch your first survey
tourSteps.body: Try the Quick actions panel on the dashboard to start the guided “Launch a survey” task.

tourSteps.title: Make it yours
tourSteps.body: Open your profile menu to switch dark mode, enable accessibility mode, and reset demo data any time.
